An "'''ancient and evil people'''" was how the [[Muza]] [[Species/Legends|species]] described the former inhabitants of the [[Kabus-Dabeh]] ruins on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]. This civilization left behind great ruins, which included a [[Kabus-Dabeh pyramid|pyramid]] with [[Kabus-Dabeh statues|fearsome-looking statues]] on it.<ref name="RoKD ">{{WEGCite|story=Ruins of Kabus-Dabeh|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref> By [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], this ancient people had disappeared, leaving only Kabus-Dabeh to mark their former existence.<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref>
